name: Horizon Starport Propellant Depot
summary: The cryogenic tank farms of the largest starport on Mars. Liquid oxygen and liquid methane arrive by pipeline and are drawn down when a ship loads: about 2,600 t of LOX and 730 t of methane per ship.
story: Horizon City was built from 2148, with the Martian space elevator going up beside it. Horizon Starport, finished in 2153, became the largest starport on Mars, where most cargo changes hands.
process: LOX tank farm, 3,600 m3 (4,100 t); liquid methane tank farm, 2,700 m3 (1,140 t)
Zero-boil-off cryocoolers; residual boil-off about 0.05 % per day
Ship loading draws both farms down from 85 % to about 22 % over 30 hours

sources.label: SpaceX Starship: about 1,200 t of propellant at an O/F ratio near 3.6
Plachta and Kittel 2003, An updated zero boil-off cryogenic propellant storage analysis for upper stages or depots (NASA)
Densities of liquid oxygen and methane (NIST Chemistry WebBook)
